title: Latch configuration
description: Project checks, automatic hook conditions, and output settings.

turn_end_feedback.description: Allow a supported harness to act on a failed turn-end check in one follow-up. The default is report.

defaults.description: Defaults for explicit hooks and discovered project scripts.

turn_end.description: Checks after a coding agent finishes a turn.

after_edit.description: Checks after a native edit tool completes.

commands.description: Legacy turn-end command list. Use hooks for new configurations.
Commands in execution order. Each command starts with an executable and includes one string per argument.

when.description: Controls when automatic checks run. The built-in default is workspace_changed.

on_success.description: Controls successful output. The built-in default is silent.

on_failure.description: Continue the command list or stop at the first failure. The built-in default is collect.

failure_output.description: How automatic hooks and tools present a failure. The built-in default is excerpt.

tail_lines.description: Number of lines shown per stream in tail mode. The built-in default is 20.

rtk_filter.description: Filter name for a separately installed RTK. The built-in default is log.

event.description: One check definition or several in execution order. An empty list disables the event.

paths.description: Git-worktree-relative globs matched against changed files.

extensions.description: Case-insensitive final file suffixes matched against changed files.
